title: Glasshouse evidence ledger
description: What financial institutions publicly commit to vs. what they do. Every record carries source_url, retrieval_date, primary_ref, resolution_type. DPA/NPA are not convictions; dockets are allegations; quarantined rows are leads, not findings. See METHODOLOGY.md.

votes.description: SEC Form N-PX proxy votes, one row per voteRecord. Source: filings.source_url per accession.

enforcement_actions.description: Enforcement universe. resolution_type is legally material: guilty_plea != dpa != npa != civil_settlement. 'unverified' rows and rows without primary_ref are quarantined.

commitments.description: Versioned, content-addressed snapshots of institutions' own published policies (live + Wayback).

holdings.description: SEC Form 13-F holdings (full dollars). Holdings alone are the weakest evidence class: the passive-index alibi applies.

match_log.description: Every fuzzy entity-match attempt, accepted or not. Precision over recall.
